title: A protocol for _in vivo_ detection of reactive oxygen species
protocol: Collect larvae of the right developmental stage with a paintbrush and place them in PBS in three well plates, at room temperature.
Alternatively, anaesthetize females of the correct age and collect them in 2ml eppendorf tubes for adult tissue dissection.
Dissect tissue of interest in 1XPBS in three well glass plates.
Reconstitute dye right after dissection and immediately before use in anhydrous DMSO.
Dissolve 1 microlitre of the reconstituted dye (in DMSO) in 1ml of 1X PBS to give a final concentration of 10uM.
Vortex to evenly disperse the dye.
Vortex the mixture for about 15 to 30 seconds.
Incubate the tissue with the dye for 5 to 15 minutes in a dark chamber on an orbital shaker at room temperature.
Perform three 5-minute washes in 1XPBS on an orbital shaker at room temperature.
Mount the tissue immediately in vectashield.
Capture an image immediately using a confocal microscope.
Collect and dissect tissue as described previously.
Reconstitute dye right after dissection and immediately before use in anhydrous DMSO.
Ensure that the reconstituted dye solution appears slightly pink in color.
Dissolve 1 microlitre of the reconstituted dye in 1ml of Schneider's medium to give a final concentration of approximately 30uM.
Vortex to evenly disperse the dye.
Incubate the tissue with the dye for 3 to 7 minutes in a dark chamber on an orbital shaker at room temperature.
Perform three 5-minute washes in Schneider's medium in a dark chamber, on an orbital shaker at room temperature.
(Optional) Fix slightly for 4 to 8 minutes in 7% formaldehyde in 1X PBS.
Rinse once in 1X PBS right after fixation.
Mount immediately in Vectashield.
Capture images immediately using a confocal microscope.
